response.overview: I Choose Happiness (2025) from Peter Chambers is a short Australian film that blends humour with thoughtful attention to themes of motivation, individuality and medical disability. With a tone aimed at adults, the film touches on motor neurone disease while offering moments of levity and human warmth. It sits well within the Focus on Ability International Short Film Festival program, which celebrates the skills, experiences and achievements of people with disability. Presented here as part of that conversation, I Choose Happiness invites audiences to laugh and reflect without simplifying complex realities. A compact, humane piece that prompts both smiles and thought.
response.title: I Choose Happiness
